_note: Catalogue audit of 2026-09-14 (owner's testing note 5, DEC-093). Applied by scripts/merge_research_delivery.py after every delivery, like any overlay. Each entry says why. Renames change a record's display name and so its exam_id; they never change a value a notice published.

BPSC Current Recruitment Photograph Spec.why: The old name was the research brief's scope label, not an examination. The record covers BPSC's online application and one-time registration.

DSSSB Major Recruitment Examination Fami.why: Scope label. The record covers DSSSB's recruitment applications.

RBI Officers in Grade B 2026 - prior-cyc.why: 'prior-cycle official fallback' described how the research sourced the record, which the record's provenance already carries.

remove_records.RBI Assistant - Panel Year 2025 (live ph: An exact copy of 'RBI Assistant - Panel Year 2025': the same notice (opportunities.rbi.org.in Id=4912) and the same five deliverables, the live photograph among them. One examination, one page.

BPSC Current Recruitment Photograph Spec.Candidate signature: Not a separate item: BPSC's application instructions (bpsconline.bihar.gov.in, Instruction_Online_Application.pdf, Step 6) ask for exactly one English and one Hindi signature, both kept as 'Candidate signature (English)' and 'Candidate signature (Hindi)'.
BPSC Current Recruitment Photograph Spec.English signature: Duplicate of 'Candidate signature (English)', from a user manual whose certificate could not be verified; the application instructions state the same figures.

CUET (PG) 2026.Category/PwD certificate: Covered by 'Category certificate' and 'PwD/PwBD certificate', both listed separately in the information bulletin; this combined entry came from a portal page with no specification.

CUET (UG) 2026.PwD certificate: Duplicate of 'PwD/UDID certificate', which carries the bulletin's PDF 50-300 KB specification.

UGC-NET June 2026.PwD certificate: Duplicate of 'PwD/PwBD certificate', which carries the bulletin's PDF 50-300 KB specification.

ICSI Student Registration / Examination.Identity/address/category proof: Duplicate of 'Identity proof', which carries ICSI's published formats and size.

NEET (UG) 2026.Category/PwBD/citizenship certificate: A generic entry from an earlier source; the bulletin lists the citizenship, category and PwBD documents as their own items, which are kept.
